caption: The drawing depicts a tan or light brown vest shown from both the front and back views, side by side on a plain, off-white background. The front view, on the left side, displays a sleeveless vest with a notched lapel collar, two horizontal welt pockets near the waist, and a vertical row of ten round buttons down the center. The back view, on the right side, reveals a single central vent that opens downward from the hem and two vertical decorative lines resembling darts or seams that curve inward toward the waist. The vest is illustrated with subtle shading to indicate folds and structure, and the overall drawing is rendered in a soft, realistic style using muted tones. A small signature, "S. Swanson," appears in the lower right corner.
title: T. Jefferson's Vest
